name: harmonicPartial
statement: harmonicPartial : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, 1 / (i + 1)
docstring: The `n`-th partial sum of the harmonic series; the sums grow without bound.
why: The divergence clause names a theorem with no counterpart in the definition — a definition asserts nothing, so any property claimed in its docstring beyond the body itself is prose saying more.
